title: Flaky: AzureSqlPrincipalReconciliationTests fail because SqlServerContainerFixture cannot bind port 1433 (address already in use)
job_name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Hosting.Azure.Tests, Hosting.Azure, Hosting.Azure, tests/Aspire... / Hosting.Azure (ubuntu-latest)
error_pattern: Class fixture type 'Aspire.Hosting.Azure.Tests.SqlServerContainerFixture' threw in InitializeAsync ---- Docker.DotNet.DockerApiException : Docker API responded with status code=InternalServerError, response={"message":"failed to set up container networking: driver failed programming external connectivity on endpoint stupefied_lovelace: failed to bind host port for 0.0.0.0::172.17.0.3:1433/tcp: address already in use"}
analysis: All seven failing tests share the exact same root cause: the shared SqlServerContainerFixture used by AzureSqlPrincipalReconciliationTests could not start its Docker container because port 1433 was already bound on the CI runner ('address already in use'). This is a Docker/port-contention issue on the shared runner, not a code defect. The PR only modifies third-party dependency versions and playground/package files, none of which touch Aspire.Hosting.Azure.Tests or the SqlServerContainerFixture. This matches a previously tracked recurring flaky-test cause with 5 prior occurrences (issue #19014).
